name: Master of Urban and Regional Planning
previous: Planning experts work strategically, often with competing stakeholders, to achieve the best social, environmental and economic outcomes. The course is accredited with the Planning Institute of Australia and graduates are eligible for membership of the Institute's Urban and Regional Planning Chapter.

name: Bachelor of Economics
previous:

Graduates work in laboratory research, biotechnology and pharmaceuticals, diagnostics and further postgraduate study.
